title: Ramp Down and Ramp Up lines on the Logic of Plan "QA ETM-8042 8836"

steps.do: Open the Shutdown Logic page, collapse histogram, read Gantt start
steps.expected: Start Date is 15 Feb 2026 (Plan Ramp Down), not 08 Feb 2026
steps.why: Not 08 Feb: the work rows all read Feb 15 and the first day header is Sun 15/02. But the time axis begins at Sat 14/02 22:00 (ticks 22:00, 23:00, 00:00 ... then Sun 15/02), so the very first axis column is 14 Feb, 2 hours before 15 Feb. No 'Start Date' field on the page. Person to decide if this lead-in counts as Start Date 15 Feb.

steps.do: Zoom out the Gantt (Ctrl+wheel) and read both lines
steps.expected: Ramp Down line at 15 Feb 2026 09:00, Ramp Up line at 25 Feb 2026 18:00
steps.why: Hour zoom: label Ramp Down sits at the 09:00 tick of Sun 15/02. Zoomed out (4.286 px/day, 15 Feb at x=1109, 22 Feb at x=1139): Ramp Down line left=781.607, Ramp Up line left=826.071, gap 44.464 px = 10.375 days = 10 d 9 h, so Ramp Up = 15 Feb 09:00 + 10 d 9 h = 25 Feb 18:00. The lines have no time text, time computed from pixels. framed 2.
